scope: High-value existing unpaid orders on the connected Huawei NCO-AL00 running HarmonyOS 4.2; no real payments
fix: Repeated observations of the same active JD cashier no longer rebuild the OCR session and discard two-frame stability evidence. Payment selection changes, navigation, and session expiry retain invalidation behavior.

matrix.evidence: User confirmed reminder appeared, was clickable and matched final WeChat payable. No Taobao path code changed in 2.45.7.
Agent observed reminder before checkout; user confirmed final payable matched. No Taobao path code changed in 2.45.7.
Agent screenshot showed full-screen reminder over WeChat cashier with source payable; user clicked continue and confirmed amount matched. Pre-fix 2.45.6 failed this same route.
Agent observed reminder and countdown over Alipay, matched final payable, clicked reminder continue and observed cashier still waiting for payment.

limitations: This is evidence for the observed device, app versions and existing orders; it does not establish all possible merchants, promotions, future app versions or OEMs.
